description: Curated SIL OFL / Apache-2.0 font library for Instagram quote overlays. Each entry includes visual description, best use-cases, and when to avoid it.

fonts.name: Montserrat
fonts.visual: Clean geometric sans with open counters and a modern, confident feel. Works well for contemporary, editorial-style quotes.

fonts.name: Open Sans
fonts.visual: Friendly, neutral sans with excellent legibility at small sizes. Reads as approachable and professional.

fonts.name: Roboto
fonts.visual: Mechanical skeleton with friendly curves. Dense, authoritative presence that commands attention.

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.visual: Ultra-neutral sans designed for screen readability. Invisible typography — lets the quote speak.

fonts.name: Poppins
fonts.visual: Geometric sans with circular curves and a playful, modern energy. Stands out without being loud.

fonts.name: Raleway
fonts.visual: Elegant, high-contrast sans inspired by Art Deco signage. Thin weights feel luxurious; bold feels editorial.

fonts.name: Work Sans
fonts.visual: Humanist sans built for clarity on screens. Warm, readable, and unobtrusive.

fonts.name: Cormorant Garamond
fonts.visual: Refined Old Style serif with delicate contrast and timeless elegance. Reads like a classic book.

fonts.name: Libre Baskerville
fonts.visual: Bold, authoritative serif with strong character. Built for long reading — dense and commanding.

fonts.name: Lora
fonts.visual: Well-rounded calligraphic serif with warm, readable curves. Bridges traditional and modern.

fonts.name: Spectral
fonts.visual: Smart, high-contrast serif with a scholarly feel. Crisp and distinctive at every size.

fonts.name: DM Serif Display
fonts.visual: Bold serif with dramatic contrast and a confident, editorial presence. Commands attention.

fonts.name: EB Garamond 12
fonts.visual: Authentic Renaissance-era serif with authentic letterforms. Reads like a 16th-century manuscript.

fonts.name: Crimson Text
fonts.visual: Optimized for long reading — warm, familiar, and highly legible. Feels like a trusted book.

fonts.name: Abril Fatface
fonts.visual: Extremely high-contrast display serif with thick blacks and hairline whites. Dramatic and eye-catching.

fonts.name: Anton
fonts.visual: Tall, heavy sans with a bold, blocky presence. Reads as loud and confident.

fonts.name: Bebas Neue
fonts.visual: All-caps condensed sans with a poster / editorial feel. Striking and memorable.

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.visual: Modern monospace with a tall x-height and clear glyphs. Reads as technical and precise.

fonts.name: IBM Plex Mono
fonts.visual: Refined monospace with a slightly condensed width. Professional and clean.

fonts.name: Space Mono
fonts.visual: Bold, wide monospace with a retro-futuristic feel. Distinctive and memorable.

fonts.name: Caveat
fonts.visual: Casual, natural handwriting with a friendly, personal feel. Like a note from a friend.

fonts.name: Dancing Script
fonts.visual: Elegant, flowing script with graceful curves. Feels celebratory and warm.

fonts.name: Great Vibes
fonts.visual: Luxurious, flowing cursive with dramatic flourishes. Reads as premium and refined.

fonts.name: Allura
fonts.visual: Soft, romantic cursive with gentle curves. Feels intimate and personal.

fonts.name: Sacramento
fonts.visual: Light, flowing single-stroke script with a minimalist elegance. Subtle and refined.

fonts.name: Pacifico
fonts.visual: Retro 1950s-inspired script with bold, friendly curves. Fun and approachable.

fonts.name: Parisienne
fonts.visual: Elegant, flowing French-inspired script with graceful curves. Romantic and refined.

fonts.name: Playfair Display
fonts.visual: High-contrast editorial serif with dramatic thick-thin transitions. Bold, luxurious, and attention-grabbing.

fonts.name: Oswald
fonts.visual: Tall, condensed sans inspired by classic gothic letterforms. Strong and authoritative.
